locations.note: Holmes and Watson begin in London investigating the disappearance of a Maori servant.
A Swiss asylum, the Black Edelweiss Institute, hides a link to the disappearances; the game never says where in Switzerland.
The investigation crosses the Atlantic to New Orleans in pursuit of a cult.
The final lighthouse confrontation takes place on the remote Scottish coast.
Evidence from the docks and the temple comes back to the rooms at 221B for the microscope and the chemistry bench.

routes.name: Holmes and Watson
routes.note: The story returns to London between New Orleans and Scotland, then ends back in London.
